wrap_grasp.method: Palm and opposed thumb support; three contacting fingers curl past the handle center with >=115 degrees total flexion; two contact proximal links or pads >=15 mm from their tips; retained for 3 s

controller_type: Scripted IK and joint-drive targets; no RL training
knife_collision: Separate blade and handle hulls on the existing rigid body

closure_sequence.method: Fingers contact first; thumb closing commands held until 2 fingers support for 0.15 s. Incidental contact with the stationary thumb is reported separately.

limitations: Provisional rigid-body grip and friction settings; not calibrated to hardware
Simplified kitchen materials and nearby kitchen collisions only
